content: Over a period of 4 years, finerenone was shown to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events, including cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or hospitalization for heart failure, by 13% compared to placebo. Additionally, finerenone demonstrated a 36% reduction in the risk of end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) and a 57% reduction in the risk of sustained decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) from baseline.
